name: Le Bristol Paris
positioning: Grand, traditionally decorated Oetker Collection hotel on rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré in Paris, with a long history and a nautical-themed indoor pool
best_for: Travelers who want a classic Paris hotel close to the Champs-Élysées
Food lovers interested in restaurants led by Chef Arnaud Faye
Guests who enjoy traditional decor with original paintings and antiques

facts.text: Le Bristol Paris is at 112 rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré in Paris.
The hotel is a stone's throw from the Champs-Élysées, and Place de l'Opéra is within walking distance.
Le Bristol is named after Bishop Frederick Hervey, 4th Earl of Bristol, an eighteenth-century traveller.
During World War II, the property served as the home of the American Embassy.
Famous guests over the years have included Charlie Chaplin and Rita Hayworth.
Each room is unique in decoration and colour.
Room decor is traditional, enhanced with original paintings and antique furniture.
The spa is Spa Le Bristol by La Mer.
Le Jardin Français is the hotel's courtyard garden, with a fountain.
Bristol After Dark takes place at Le Bar du Bristol.
The hotel offers guests electric bicycles to ride.
Wheelchairs and shower chairs are available to guests on request, and there is an accessible lift in the lobby.

highlights.text: The nautical-themed indoor pool was created by the same designer that did the Onassis yacht, and it is heated in all seasons.
The hotel's resident Burmese cat, Socrate, wears a bespoke Goyard collar.
Le Bristol Paris's restaurants are led by Chef Arnaud Faye, Meilleur Ouvrier de France.
The hotel's kitchens include a chocolatier, a pasta-making kitchen, a patisserie and a bakery where wheat is milled fresh each day.
The indoor rooftop swimming pool has views over Montmartre and the Eiffel Tower.

considerations.text: There is no open outdoor space for children at the hotel.
The decor is traditional, with original paintings and antique furniture, rather than a contemporary look.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing and a formal atmosphere that may not suit casual travelers.
